facts.text: This hotel bar is the only quiet place left in the whole city.
facts.why: Not a line Bob says. It is printed in quote marks. Bob does talk about the whiskey working when he first speaks to Charlotte in the bar.

facts.text: A shabu-shabu dinner with new friends
facts.why: The shabu-shabu scene is a lunch for Bob and Charlotte alone, and it is tense because Charlotte heard the jazz singer in Bob's room. It is not a dinner with new friends.

facts.why: Bob and Charlotte do walk and run through Tokyo at night, but no source gives a time of 3am, so only the time is dropped.

facts.text: Room service at 3am, Charlotte still awake.
facts.why: Charlotte and Bob struggle with jet lag and cannot sleep, but no room service or 3am scene shows in the plot or transcript.
